entries.detail: Owner decision 2026-09-03: do NOT run the DB-bound suites on this machine. The report DB is CGNAT-internal, so every test in these classes fails after a 15s pre-login handshake timeout. Gates MUST pass the DB-skip filter in _gate-common.md section 3 so these never execute; with it the suite is 1538 tests in 4 seconds. The single 15s dbAvailable probe still runs so the gate can report DB state honestly.
